## Date of proposal:   
In Draft
 
## Problem:      
During the process of upgrading Edgeware’s network a lot of holes where hit in the road, one of them was dealing with Edgeware’s out of date testing suit. Flipchan now proposes a plan for a new tool to make running tests before and after a runtime upgrade easier.
 
## Goal:    
Provide more documentation and a stable testing suit that makes it easy and straightforward for developers to test runtime upgrade and pallet functionality. At the same time Introduce the new tool “uptest”.

 
## Introduction:   
Flipchan has previously been tasked to perform a massive runtime upgrade, The upgrade was very complex and a lot of holes were found in the road. But thanks to this experience flipchan has gotten a clear landscape of how Edgeware’s chains operated and wishes to spend his time on:     

#### 1: Upgrading edgeware’s current testing kit(https://github.com/hicommonwealth/edgeware-state-tester).  
Right now the tests for Edgeware are out of date, the process of porting them to a better and more feature rich implementation has been started by flipchan()
 
 
#### 2: Documentation     
There is currently a giant lack of documentation in the substrate space for performing Runtime upgrades and doing proper testing of the chain. Therefor two guides are going to be ad
